name: What is the process for custom stair construction?
description: The custom stair construction process involves consultation, design, material sourcing, fabrication, and on-site installation.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for custom stair construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The custom stair construction process begins with an initial consultation to discuss design ideas, materials, and budget. This is followed by detailed design and engineering, where plans are drawn up for client approval. Once approved, materials are sourced, and the staircase components are fabricated, often off-site. The final phase involves on-site installation and finishing. Hometelligent Inc. manages this entire sequence, including coordinating with other trades if necessary, to ensure a smooth transition from concept to a completed, ready-to-use staircase.
acceptedAnswer.description: The custom stair construction process involves consultation, design, material sourcing, fabrication, and on-site installation.
